rows.label: tlk43300241_04_msg0001
rows.name:
Refugees from Acedia have landed
not far from Quvere Battleship Yard.

rows.label: tlk43300241_04_msg0002
rows.name:
That's Invidian hospitality
for you. We're all floored by
Queen Lagert's benevolence.

rows.label: tlk43300241_04_msg0003
rows.name:
The people of Fons Maim have also
accepted them, getting ready for
a life built side by side.

rows.label: tlk43300241_04_msg0004
rows.name:
Like the distribution center. The
sight moves me every time. I want
to immortalize it in my art.

rows.label: tlk43300241_04_msg0005
rows.name:
I can almost hear the insults:
'A noble's son, even at a time like
this...'
